examples.en: Do we dance in order to make ourselves feel better, calmer, healthier?
examples.zh: 我们跳舞是为了让自己感觉更好、更平静、更健康吗？

examples.en: So, do we dance in order to make ourselves feel better, calmer, healthier?
examples.zh: 那么，我们跳舞是为了让自己感觉更好、更平静、更健康吗？

examples.en: The research also found that mentally well-adjusted owners had calmer, happier and healthier cats.
examples.zh: 研究还发现，心理上适应良好的主人养的猫更平静、更快乐、更健康。
